title: MessagePack
description: A fast binary serialization library for .NET with support for zero-copy and contractless serialization.

data.text: MessagePack for C# is an extremely fast binary serialization library. It is smaller and faster than JSON and Protocol Buffers, making it ideal for high-performance scenarios like game networking and inter-process communication.

data.title: Serialization

terms.definition: An attribute marking a class for MessagePack serialization.
Maps a property to a MessagePack field index.

data.title: Performance
data.text: MessagePack produces smaller payloads and is often 10x faster than JSON serialization.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: MessagePack is a fast binary format
data.takeaway: Use MessagePack for high-performance serialization in networking and caching.

data.title: Exercise
data.description: Serialize an object to MessagePack binary format.
data.expectedOutcome: A binary MessagePack representation of the object.
